## Check on 2026-11-24 (82 shipped audio files; 84 audited in dev repo — `alt_haunted_track.ogg` and `alt_music_box_waltz.ogg` are unwired alternates excluded from release; details in `docs/AUDIO_ASSET_INVENTORY_20261124.md`)

- Every one of the 84 files is listed here, and every sha256 given here matches the file on disk (one typo in the `punch_heavy.ogg` hash was fixed).
- The source pages were opened in a browser on 2026-11-24. 33 of 35 OpenGameArt pages show "License(s): CC0" (the page shows no other licence); 4 Kenney pages show "Creative Commons CC0"; 10 BigSoundBank pages show "CC0 (public domain)".
- Not confirmed: `ambient/ghost_moan1.ogg` and `ambient/ghost_moan3.ogg` cite https://opengameart.org/content/ghost-moans, which now answers 404, so the licence line recorded on 2026-11-09 is the only evidence. `sfx/status_frost_owner.ogg`, `status_shock_owner.ogg`, `status_slow_owner.ogg` and `status_stun_owner.ogg` came from Pixabay (owner, 2026-11-24) and are under the Pixabay Content License, not CC0; their exact pages and authors are not recorded.
- Nine BigSoundBank files name only the site. Their exact page was not recorded; BigSoundBank pages of the same kind all show CC0.
- The 22 Gemini-generated files (`throw_*_gemini`, `throw_cannon_rocket`, `throw_soundwave_sonic`, `impact_flame_evil_spell`, and the 15 `ult_*`) are not CC0 material; the owner states commercial use is allowed under the tool's terms (confirmation open in `docs/ASSET_PROVENANCE.md`).
